newsitem.title: CUBA: Cuban bands start salsa marathon.
newsitem.headline: Cuban bands start salsa marathon.

text.p: Hundreds of gyrating couples packed Havana's Salon Rosado dance theatre on Saturday night as Los Van Van, Cuba's best known salsa band, kicked off what organisers hope will be the world's longest non-stop salsa concert.

The concert began shortly after 10 p.m. (0300 GMT Sunday) and was set to run continuously until 10 p.m. Wednesday (0300 GMT Thursday), with a maximum pause of 10 seconds' silence allowed between bands.

Los Van Van were to be joined by some 2,000 musicians from 80 bands taking part in the event, organised by a record company and the Cuban Music Institute and aiming to break a record of 30-hours non-stop live salsa music set by a Barcelona club last year.
The Salon Rosado is a popular open-air night spot and it was packed to capacity on Saturday night. Hundreds of people waited outside to be allowed in later in the night.
